ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central high-intensity region bordered by low-intensity distal tips and a vertical low-intensity band extending from the median notch to the peduncle. The right distal tip contains a solid dark contiguous block, while the left distal tip features a complex, fragmented network of dark lines and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth reaching approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with variable pixel-amplitude; notable high-amplitude indentation (loss of material) on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe; right lobe trailing edge exhibits more uniform, smaller-scale jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edges with a complex, irregular trajectory on the trailing edges featuring localized concavities near the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Cluster of approximately five circular high-contrast white spots (diameter 5-10 pixels) localized within the dark pigmentation of the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive series of parallel, dark-pixel linear rake marks visible across the white interior of both lobes; most prominent on the left lobe spanning a horizontal width of approximately 40 pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major irregular notch/trauma site on the trailing edge of the left lobe; multiple sets of parallel rake marks consistent with interspecific interaction across the mid-ventral white plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'scribble' pigmentation pattern on the distal-most region of the left lobe, characterized by a high-density intersection of thin linear dark marks.
